newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian shares inch higher, seen shackled.
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares inch higher, seen shackled.

text.p: Austrian shares inched higher on Wednesday, holding out above the key 1,300 points level in the ATX index but closing below session highs after oscillating in a tight 10-point range for most of the day.

Traders said they expected the index to continue moving sideways in a narrow corridor between 1,290 and 1,310 points this weeks as investors continued to search for fresh leads amid growing uncertainty over the outlook for Europe's planned single currency.
"The uncertainty is really weighing on prices," said one.
The index rose 2.83 points or 0.22 percent to close the day at 1,300.56 points. Among its constituents, 14 losers outweighed seven gainers.
Gainers were led by oil and gas group OMV, rising 1.32 percent to finish at 1,552 schillings. The day's top loser was hosiery maker Wolford, falling 2.02 percent to 1,215 schillings.
On the Vienna futures and options exchange, ATX contracts for June delivery were up four points at 1,305.0 on turnover of 479 contracts.
